scope: Additional CPU-only output consistency analysis registered before the resilience campaign begins; no new inference or label access
input: Completed hybrid soak_60min client request journal
grouping: Source review identity; order successful deliveries by client attempt index
measurement: Compare the complete aspect-sentiment prediction set for every repeated successful delivery with the first successful delivery of that review
report: reviews with any differing prediction set
boundaries: Agreement is a within-configuration consistency observation on repeated development inputs, not evidence of accuracy, new independent quality samples, numeric score equivalence or general determinism. Failed attempts are retained separately. No threshold or system setting is selected from this result.
privacy: Only counts and evidence hashes are exported; no review identities, text, gold labels or raw predictions
